rules.additional_heroes: taverns forbidden for both sides; no other hero sources
rules.defeat: standard loss of all heroes and towns, or seven days without a town
rules.fog: normal engine team fog; no reveal events
rules.hero_specialties: Orrin: archery; Edric: griffins; neither applies to the starting pikemen
rules.neutral_stacks: six pikemen each, savage, never flee, no growth; no reward artifact/resources
rules.symmetry: equal starting armies and primary stats; approximate geometric symmetry does not promise equal initial visibility
rules.towns: fort and first-tier dwelling; other construction is not scripted or automated for the agent

seed_effect: cosmetic dirt variants only; engine seed is supplied separately
verification_note: Generator metadata only; consult committed run validation for engine loading and gameplay.
